mapper.select: select * from Investment_Budget_Breakdown where Project_ID = #{projectId} and state!=3

select ibb.*,pro.P_Name as projectName, sf.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, pro.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment,sd.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, pro.P_Apply_File as projectApplyFile, pro.P_Approve_budget as pApproveBudget, pro.p_record_amount as pRecordAmount, pro.p_approval_amount as pApprovalAmount, pro.p_project_form_type as pProjectFormType, pro.p_inv_total as pInvTotal from Investment_Budget_Breakdown ibb left join Pre_Project pro on ibb.Project_ID = pro.P_ID left join SYS_Department sd on pro.P_Competent_Department = sd.D_ID left join sys_file sf on ibb.id=sf.FileId where ibb.id = #{id}

select ibb.*, pro.P_Name as projectName, sf.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, pro.P_Competent_Department as pCompetentDepartment, sd.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, pro.P_Apply_File as projectApplyFile, pro.P_Approve_budget as pApproveBudget, pro.p_record_amount as pRecordAmount, pro.p_approval_amount as pApprovalAmount, pro.p_project_form_type as pProjectFormType, pro.p_inv_total as pInvTotal from Investment_Budget_Breakdown ibb left join Pre_Project pro on ibb.Project_ID = pro.P_ID left join SYS_Department sd on pro.P_Competent_Department = sd.D_ID left join sys_file sf on ibb.id=sf.FileId where ibb.Project_ID = #{pId}
select * from Investment_Budget_Breakdown where Project_ID = #{projectId} and state=7 order by Create_Time desc

SELECT distinct ${value} as dbValue FROM pre_project mn LEFT JOIN sys_company sc ON sc.c_id = mn.P_Construction_Unit LEFT JOIN SYS_Department sd ON mn.P_Competent_Department = sd.D_ID LEFT JOIN Investment_Budget_Breakdown ibb ON ibb.Project_ID = mn.P_ID AND ibb.state = 7 LEFT JOIN (SELECT p_id, SUM(fp_Received) AS allInvestment FROM Fund_Plan WHERE state = 7 GROUP BY p_id) fp ON fp.p_id = mn.p_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT brea.Project_ID, COUNT(*) AS pBudgetInvestmentCount FROM Investment_Budget_Breakdown_Details details LEFT JOIN Investment_Budget_Breakdown brea ON details.Isb_ID = brea.id WHERE brea.state = 7 GROUP BY brea.Project_ID) bb ON bb.Project_ID = mn.p_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT p_id, SUM(Pay_Apply) AS payApplySum FROM con_pay WHERE Pay_State = 7 AND pay_Category IN ('01', '02', '03') GROUP BY p_id) cp ON cp.p_id = mn.p_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT project_id, SUM(apply_Amount) AS travelExpensesSum FROM travel_expenses_apply WHERE approve_status = 7 GROUP BY project_id) te ON te.project_id = mn.p_id
